utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Vik, quick heads-up: I’m slammed, but I can bring a couple extension cords and cover check-in for the first hour Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Bo—I’ll pass along that you can bring extension cords and cover check-in for the first hour Saturday morning, though I’m still waiting on Nell and Marisol to confirm the exact time and place.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks—just send me the exact time and place once they confirm, and I’ll plan on the cords plus first-hour check-in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Faye, just a quick update: the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, so I’m checking who can still help and what supplies we should bring.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Rosa—that helps a lot. Sunday at the community center should be easier around pickup, and I’ll check with Bo and Noah about whether they can still help and what supplies they’re bringing.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Faye—that would be wonderful. If you can let me know what Bo and Noah confirm by tomorrow, I’ll keep the volunteer and supply list tidy.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sam, I’ve got the loose railing first and the leaky hose bib second on my note—do you know if that 3:30 to 5 window is confirmed before I pass it along to Faye?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I haven’t heard that the 3:30 to 5 window is confirmed yet, Oren. I’d check with Tess or Leo before you pass it along to Faye.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, thank you, Sam—I’ll check with Tess or Leo before telling Faye anything firm. Now I just have to remember where I put that note by the door.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Noah, I’m waiting on the final time and place from Nell and Marisol, but I’m already lining up people for sorting, hauling, sign-in, and repair help. Do you know anyone who’d want to pitch in once we’ve got the details?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey Jules—yeah, I’m a bit behind, but I can ask around once Nell and Marisol confirm the time and place. I might be able to help Saturday afternoon too, if you still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d be wonderful, Noah—once Nell and Marisol lock in the details, I’ll send them your way so you can ask around. And I’ll pencil you in as a maybe for Saturday afternoon hands-on help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Ira, we’re still gathering repair items and volunteers for the drive, and Noah is likely helping Saturday afternoon. If you know any urgent repairs or someone with tools, send them my way so we can match people up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Mara—I’ve heard Gus may have tools and hands-on help, so I’ll point him your way. I’m still waiting on the posted time and accepted repairs, but I’ll keep spreading the word while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Ira—that’s perfect; send Gus my way if he’s willing, and I’ll wait on the posted time and accepted repairs before promising folks specifics.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Leo, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—kickoff time still isn’t confirmed, but it may focus on leaky gutters and porch steps. Want me to loop you in once the details are firm?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yes, loop me in when it’s firm. I’ll line up tools and check-in around whatever time they set.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, thanks Leo—I’ll keep the kickoff marked as pending for now and send you the firm time as soon as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Uli, sorry I’m jumping in late—do you know if they still need hands for sorting or hauling after sign-in?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I think Rey’s already covering the quiet tool-sorting, but hauling after sign-in may still need hands. I haven’t seen the latest signup sheet yet, so maybe check with Rosa or Hana before you commit.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Uli—that helps. I’ll check with Rosa or Hana before I lock it in, but I can probably stick around after sign-in if hauling’s still short.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Nell, I’m still waiting on the confirmed kickoff time for the repair drive, so don’t spread 3:30 to 5 as firm just yet. Sam’s covering tables, tool bins, and extension cords, though, so that part’s in good hands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it, Tess — I’ll keep 3:30 to 5 strictly tentative and only pass along that Sam has the tables, tool bins, and extension cords covered.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thank you, Nell — the minute Quinn or Eli hears the confirmed time, I’ll holler so we can pass it along properly.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Gus, can you help Saturday morning, and what tools or repair skills can we actually count on from you?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Mina—I’ll be there Saturday morning with my toolbox, and you can count on me for basic fixes like loose hinges, wobbly chairs, small hardware repairs, and lending tools where folks need them.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, Gus—what time Saturday can you be there, and does your toolbox include a drill, bits, and spare screws?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Hana. I’m interested in the repair drive, but I’m still waiting on a firm time, place, and a posted repair list before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Morning, Eli—thanks for being clear. I’ll hold off on marking you committed until we have the time, place, and repair list posted, and I can check back with you then.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thank you, Hana—that suits me fine. Once the details are posted, I’ll look them over and give you a definite answer.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll do that quietly, Cleo—I’ll check with the closest neighbors and send you names with any screws, wrench sets, or plumber’s tape they can spare before evening.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thank you, Rey—send it when you have it, and I’ll keep the list updated for the railing and hose bib repairs.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I will, Cleo. I’ll keep it simple and only send confirmed names and what they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Kira, I’m tracking the repair drive by location—do you have any items coming from your place, or a pickup/drop-off spot I should add to the list?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: I might have a lamp to add, Opal, but I’m not confirming anything until Pia verifies the time, accepted items, and the room availability—can you hold off listing my place for now?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Of course, Kira—I won’t list your place yet. I’ll mark it as pending Pia’s confirmation on time, accepted items, and room availability.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Vik, I’m quietly checking with nearby folks about urgent fixes and tools before evening. If you know of anything that needs attention first, or anyone with screws, a wrench set, or plumber’s tape, I can add it to the list.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Rey—I don’t have confirmed urgent fixes yet, but I’ll tell folks you’re gathering needs and looking for screws, a wrench set, and plumber’s tape before evening.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Vik. If anyone mentions something urgent or a tool they can spare, just send it my way and I’ll quietly pass the clearest list to Mara and Mina before evening.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Dane, I’m short on time—quick version, do you need me bringing spare tools or just dropping off labeled broken stuff Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Quick version: please drop off labeled broken stuff Saturday, and spare tools would help if they’re easy to bring. I’m covering sign-in, then Leo said sorting and late-morning hauling may still need hands.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, I’ll label a couple broken things and toss in any spare tools I can grab. I’m probably too tight for hauling, but if I’m still there late morning I’ll check in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Noah, have you actually seen the posted time and accepted repair items yet? I don’t want to repeat anything until Pia or the office confirms it.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Honestly, I haven’t seen the confirmed post yet, so I don’t want to guess either. I’ll check the sheet or wait for Pia or the office before I pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, thanks—if you do see the actual sheet before Pia gets back, can you confirm the time and accepted items with me first?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m going to check with the building office today before we announce anything—room availability, time, rules, and accepted items all need to be confirmed first.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Pia—please let me know what the office confirms, especially the room, time window, accepted items, and any drop-off rules, and I’ll keep the location list on hold until then.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Will do—I’ll ask about the community room, time window, accepted items, and drop-off rules today, and I won’t let anyone treat it as final until the office confirms.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Sam, I’m just back from errands and still trying to pin down the repair drive details—have you heard if they’ve posted the time or what repairs they’ll take?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I haven’t heard a posted time yet, Ira—I’m waiting to hear when to show up Saturday morning, but I know I’m helping with tables, tool bins, and sorting donated tools.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Sam—that helps. If you hear the Saturday time or the accepted repair list, let me know and I’ll pass it along while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Rosa, I’ve got railing repairs listed first and the garden hose bib right after; kickoff time’s still pending. If you hear of anyone with exterior screws, a wrench set, pliers, or plumber’s tape, send them my way and I’ll mark it down.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo—that priority list helps a lot. Quick update: the drive’s moved to Sunday at the community center, so I’ll route any screws, wrench sets, pliers, or plumber’s tape your way for that setup.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect, thanks Rosa—I’ll update the supplies list with Sunday at the community center and keep railing first, then the hose bib. Send any tool offers my way and I’ll track who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Quinn—before we sort out the repair drive, can you tell me what you’ve heard so far and whether you’ve seen the latest signup sheet?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hi Hana—so far I’ve only heard it may focus on leaky gutters and broken porch steps, but the kickoff time and place still aren’t confirmed. I haven’t seen the latest signup sheet yet, but I can help spread it fast once it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Quinn—that matches some of what I’m still trying to confirm. Before you spread anything, can I check the final priorities and kickoff details, then send you the latest signup sheet?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Gus — I don’t have confirmed logistics yet, but what I’ve heard second-hand is the drive may focus on leaky gutters and broken porch steps. I’ll pass along the time and place once I hear it for sure.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell—gutters and porch steps both sound doable, so I’ll make sure I bring the ladder, drill, and toolbox Saturday. Just let me know the confirmed time and place when you get it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Gus — that sounds helpful, but I still don’t want to count on Saturday until I hear it confirmed. I’ll pass you the exact time and place as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Eli, we’re still waiting on Nell and Marisol to pin down the time and place, but I’m lining up folks for sorting, hauling, sign-in, and repair help so everyone can plug in easily.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds sensible, Jules; I’ll wait for Nell and Marisol’s firm time and place before I put my name down. Once there’s a posted list, I can choose a task and stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That works, Eli—once the time and place are confirmed, I’ll make sure there’s a clear task list so you can pick a slot that fits and count on it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Leo, have you heard anything firm on the repair drive time yet? I’ve got folks asking, and I don’t want to send the wrong word around.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Only firm word I’ve got is Saturday morning. I’ll send you the exact start time as soon as it’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Leo—Saturday morning I can pass along, but I’ll hold off on the exact start until you send it so I don’t muddy the waters.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Oren—I appreciate you double-checking. If you hear anything firm about that 3:30 to 5 window, could you let me know so I can plan around pickup?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course, Faye—I won’t call it firm until Tess confirms, but I’ll let you know as soon as I hear her holler.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks Oren—that helps. I’ll keep my afternoon flexible until Tess confirms.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Mina, we’re still gathering items and volunteers, and Rey is pulling together names, skills, and urgent repairs for a clearer list tonight.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good—when Rey has that list tonight, can you send me the top three repairs and who can actually do each one? I’m not promising times or tools until Pia confirms the room and rules.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Mina—I’ll send you the top three repairs with the matched volunteers once Rey’s list comes in tonight, and I won’t lock in times or tools until Pia confirms the room and rules.
